a.text: Concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, running the generator to 8 means we will very likely both be caught with empty units. The reserve's 4 cells can save only one of us in round 1. I won't break our agreement unilaterally, and I won't take anything unless you agree. Want to renegotiate? One option: one of us takes 4 now, and the other gets priority on everything the generator makes afterward. If you'd rather keep the original plan, say so and I'll operate.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping our original agreement and will operate until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. The reserve should reach 8 after this round. Then I'll take 4 per the agreement.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.
